servers.legacy: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.1 (speaks up to 2025-11-25), example Server over stdio and stateful streamable HTTP

harness: smoke.mjs and smoke-lines.mjs spawn a server, write JSON-RPC lines, print the first reply lines; probe-http.mjs --json spawns an HTTP server, POSTs, and prints {status, body}. All run under $TMPDIR/mcp-era on 2026-10-22.

files.discover-legacy-stdio.json: server/discover at 2026-07-28 to legacy-stdio -> -32601 (the legacy fallback signal)
files.discover-legacy-http.json: server/discover POST (modern headers) to legacy-http -> 400 with legacy -32000 (the HTTP fallback signal)
files.initialize-modern-only.json: initialize at 2025-06-18 to modern-stdio -> -32022 naming supported and requested
files.initialize-modern-only-http.json: legacy initialize POST to modern-http -> 400 with -32022 (the HTTP modern signal)
files.version-missing.json: tools/call without any version to modern-stdio -> -32022 with supported but no requested
files.tools-list-modern.json: tools/list with the modern envelope to modern-stdio -> tools + resultType complete
files.tools-call-modern.json: tools/call add(40,2) with the modern envelope to modern-stdio -> 42 + resultType complete
files.tools-call-input-required.json: tools/call greet with the modern envelope (elicitation declared) to modern-elicit-stdio -> input_required with one form elicitation and a requestState
files.elicitation-create-legacy.json: initialize (elicitation declared) + tools/call greet to legacy-elicit-stdio -> the server's elicitation/create request
